insight: Built by Firebase co-founder Andrew Lee and ex-Google Inbox/Firebase engineers as a 'spiritual successor' to Google's shut-down Inbox app.
name: Shortwave
tagline: AI email client built on top of Gmail.
description: Shortwave is an AI-powered email client layered over Gmail, offering natural-language search across your inbox, AI thread summaries, and a Ghostwriter that drafts replies in your own voice. It revives Google Inbox-style features like bundling and a split inbox, with web, desktop, and mobile apps.

modelSupport.notes: AI search and assistant powered by LLMs; model choice available on higher tiers.

edge: An AI layer over Gmail — natural-language email search, thread summaries, and a voice-matching Ghostwriter, reviving Google Inbox-style bundling.
